description: Return the vault that filesystem tools (notes.*, tags.*, dataview.*, blocks.*, canvas.*, kanban.*, marp.*, templates.*, tasks.*, links.*, wiki.*, stats.vault) would resolve to right now, plus the full precedence chain so the LLM can explain to the user why that vault was picked. `reason` is `session-selected` (vault.select was called), `env-default` (fell back to OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH), or `none` (nothing configured — tools will fail until vault.select or an env var is set). When OBSIDIAN_API_URL is configured, the response also carries an `obsidianLiveInstance` note reminding the caller that workspace.* and commands.* tools target whichever vault the live Obsidian process has open, NOT the filesystem vault selected here. Also returns `config`: the effective per-vault wiki settings (folders, filenames, `staleDays`, headings) after the precedence chain per-call argument → `.kobsidian.json` in the vault (path via `KOBSIDIAN_VAULT_CONFIG_FILE`) → `KOBSIDIAN_WIKI_*` env → defaults, with the config file name and whether it exists, or an `error` when the file is malformed. Read-only.
name: vault.current

anyOf.description: A single vault entry returned by `vault.list` and `vault.current.active`.

exists.description: Whether the path exists on disk at discovery time. `false` flags stale obsidian.json entries (deleted vaults).

id.description: Stable identifier. `obsidian-app` sources use the 16-char hex id Obsidian assigns; `env-named` uses `env:<name>`; `env-default` uses `default`.

isActive.description: True if this vault is the currently session-selected vault.

isDefault.description: True if this vault matches OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH set at server startup.

lastOpened.description: ISO timestamp of when the user last opened this vault in Obsidian. Only present for `obsidian-app` sources.

name.description: Human-readable label. `obsidian-app` + `env-default` sources derive from `path.basename`; `env-named` uses the env-var suffix lowercased.

path.description: Absolute path to the vault directory.

source.description: Where kObsidian learned about this vault. `env-default` = OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH; `env-named` = an OBSIDIAN_VAULT_<NAME>=path env var; `obsidian-app` = parsed from the user's local Obsidian application config (obsidian.json).

active.description: The vault filesystem tools would resolve to right now. Null only when neither a session selection nor OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH is set.

error.description: Set when the config file exists but is malformed or fails validation. wiki.* tools fail with this message until it is fixed.

exists.description: Whether that file is present in the active vault.

file.description: Vault-relative path of the per-vault config file (KOBSIDIAN_VAULT_CONFIG_FILE, default `.kobsidian.json`).

wiki.description: Effective wiki settings after the precedence chain: per-call argument > config file > KOBSIDIAN_WIKI_* env > built-in default.

config.description: Effective per-vault configuration for `active`; null when no vault is active.

envDefault.description: The OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH value at server startup, if any.

obsidianLiveInstance.description: Present when OBSIDIAN_API_URL is configured. Explains that workspace.* and commands.* tools target the vault the live Obsidian process has open, independent of the filesystem vault selected here.

reason.description: Why `active` resolved this way: `session-selected` = set by vault.select; `env-default` = fell back to OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH; `none` = nothing is configured.

title: Current Active Vault
